entity.name: Nx / s1ngularity
entity.summary: A compromised release connects CI credential theft, package execution and attempted use of local AI tools.
entity.limit: Local AI use was attempted; the selected postmortem does not establish the success of each agent-mediated action. Actor identity is not asserted.

admission.reason: Anchor case named in chat; bridges CI supply chain and victim-side agent evidence.

entity.name: Deadbugz / productivity-suite
entity.summary: A public delivery campaign exposes delayed malicious MCP definitions after ordinary tool use.
entity.limit: Reviewed pull requests were unmerged at report time. The report confirms poisoned metadata, not successful credential theft on victims. Attribution is to a public delivery account only.

admission.reason: Named in chat; adds runtime gating and an explicit attempted-versus-confirmed distinction.

entity.name: Shai-Hulud / September wave
entity.summary: A credential-stealing npm payload spreads using publishing privileges and adds repository persistence.
entity.limit: This record models the September 2025 report. Shared behaviors with Nx do not establish common actor attribution. No AI-agent execution is asserted.

admission.reason: Supplemental StepSecurity seed adds propagation, branching and a published runtime-analysis reference.

entity.name: WhatsApp MCP sleeper
entity.summary: A controlled experiment shows one MCP integration steering actions of another trusted integration.
entity.limit: A demonstrated attack primitive, not an observed campaign. The malicious server need not be invoked directly. Exact publication date is not verified.

admission.reason: Supplemental research cited by Pillar; provides a second example of delayed metadata poisoning.

entity.name: Gambit / suspected ransomware affiliate
entity.summary: An operator used Claude Code while conducting remote intrusions; Case 1 is a scope comparator.
entity.limit: Gambit assesses a suspected The Gentlemen affiliate with medium confidence. Its playbook combines multiple intrusions; not all steps occurred in every case.

admission.reason: Direct chat URL; clarifies which telemetry is outside the victim defender’s control.
